scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it ste_postgres psql -U ste -d ste
scripts.ci:local: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.ci:local:api: pnpm --filter ./apps/api install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -r --filter ./apps/api --if-present lint && pnpm -r --filter ./apps/api --if-present typecheck && pnpm -r --filter ./apps/api --if-present test && pnpm -r --filter ./apps/api --if-present build
scripts.dev:api:sepolia: pnpm exec dotenv -e apps/api/.env.sepolia -- pnpm --filter ./apps/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:api:mainnet: pnpm exec dotenv -e apps/api/.env -- pnpm --filter ./apps/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:web:sepolia: pnpm exec dotenv -e apps/web/.env.sepolia.local -- pnpm --filter ./apps/web run dev
scripts.dev:web:mainnet: pnpm exec dotenv -e apps/web/.env.local -- pnpm --filter ./apps/web run dev
